evidence.claim: PT Kapsulindo Nusantara operates eight production machines to manufacture empty hard gelatin capsules using imported animal gelatin.

PT Kapsulindo Nusantara collaborated with the Agency for the Assessment and Application of Technology (BPPT) to develop and commercialise the Rulindo Caps, a plant-based capsule shell line made from kappa-carrageenan seaweed.

A Certificate of Analysis (COA) for a hard gelatin capsule batch documented by Scribd user specification logs details the company's precise dimension targets for size 0 capsules, showing a cap outside diameter tolerance of 7.61 to 7.65 mm (achieving 7.64 mm) and a cap double wall thickness tolerance of 0.164 to 0.264 mm (achieving 0.210 mm).

An independent research study published in the Bulletin of Animal Science used commercial hard capsule shells from PT Kapsulindo Nusantara as a benchmark control, verifying a specific average wall thickness baseline of 0.359 mm ± 0.07.

A patent issued to PT Kapsulindo Nusantara (Patent ID No. IDP000086146) describes a formulation utilizing polyvinylpyrrolidone as a disintegrant in κ-carrageenan seaweed capsule shells to regulate a 15-minute immediate-release standard, as detailed in a study in the South African Journal of Chemical Engineering.

In an in vitro dissolution study published by De Gruyter, carrageenan-alginate and carrageenan-starch hard-shell capsules prepared at the PT Kapsulindo Nusantara facility in Bogor demonstrated delayed-release functionality by resisting breakdown in acidic gastric fluid and opening when the pH rose above 4.5.

PT Kapsulindo Nusantara operates 8 production machines with an annual manufacturing capacity of 2.46 billion empty hard gelatin capsule units across sizes 00, 0, 1, 2, and 3, according to the company’s profile document.

The company partnered with the Agency for the Assessment and Application of Technology (BPPT) to modify its existing manufacturing machinery to enable the commercial production of "Rulindo Caps" seaweed-based capsule shells, adapting its operational infrastructure for non-gelatin capsule materials.

The company maintains standard manufacturing compliance for its capsule shell formulations by aligning its internal testing protocols and gelatin raw material stability specifications with the United States Pharmacopeia (USP 44, 2021) and the Indonesian Pharmacopeia (Farmakope Indonesia VI).

The company holds active certifications under local Indonesian authorities and international quality frameworks, maintaining ISO 9001:2015 certification for its production standards as well as local Halal and BPOM (Indonesian Food and Drug Authority) compliance.
